display.title: Episode 33: The Stone for the Beis HaMikdash (Erev Rosh Chodesh Av)
display.summary_short: Poor Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa longs to give something for the Beis HaMikdash; angels carry his stone, but only once he lends a finger. Plus Rosh Chodesh, a listeners' letter and Ahavas Yisroel for the Nine Days.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on Erev Rosh Chodesh Av 5742, without music during the Three Weeks. Uncle Yossi thanks even the youngest listeners for their scribbled letters, then tells of Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa, too poor to bring a gift for the Beis HaMikdash while crowds pass by with costly offerings. Praying by the roadside, he realizes the perfectly square stone he is sitting on could be a cornerstone, but it is far too heavy. After a boy recites the Shema, the story continues: five angels disguised as travelers offer to carry it, yet the stone floats in place until Rabbi Chanina touches it with his little finger, and then it sails to Yerushalayim. The lessons: every mitzvah adds a stone to the third Beis HaMikdash, and if you try your best, Hashem does the rest. Uncle Yossi explains why Rosh Chodesh is the 'head' of the month, from which its blessings flow, reads a letter and Shavuos drawing from two girls, and closes the Nine Days message: the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed because of baseless hatred, and Ahavas Yisroel will bring Moshiach.
display.lesson: Try your best and Hashem will do the rest; every mitzvah adds a stone to the third Beis HaMikdash, and love for every Jew undoes the baseless hatred that destroyed it.

sources_cited.note: Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa's stone, 'a true story as told by our Sages'.
The Shabbos Mevarchim prayer for a month of life, peace, joy and redemption.

'You are children of Hashem your G-d.'
